title: Extract Rust report-gen free functions into a Report struct with method receivers
description: The rust report-gen library has three free functions (sum, max_item, min_item). Refactor to a Report struct with method receivers while keeping the free functions as thin wrappers so all existing tests still pass.

required_artifacts: Free functions delegate to Report methods
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `cargo test` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
